outcome: DNA methylation in cord blood, fetal brain, and lung tissue
cohort: 3648 newborns from 17 cohorts without common pregnancy complications, induced delivery or caesarean section, and additional children aged 4-18 years.
finding: Gestational age at birth is associated with differential DNA methylation at numerous CpG sites, particularly in genes involved in embryonic development, with some associations observed in fetal brain and lung tissue.
